entradas.text: It was raining as Serge dropped me off at home after yet another gruelling day of work.
A guard held an umbrella over my head as I walked from the car to my front door. Inside, the house was completely dark.
I flipped on the light in the kitchen to find a note from Monica.
Ciara had called her in for a last-minute women's rights meeting. She'd dropped Deana off at a friend's and left me some food for reheating.
She'd gone to visit her parents for the night, bringing Deana along with her. They'd left me some food I could reheat for dinner.
I took the pot out of the fridge. It was filled with an unidentifiable grayish-looking stew. Evidently, Monica's excellent cooking had been the first casualty of her political career.
I took the pot out of the fridge. It was filled with an unidentifiable grayish-looking stew. Evidently, my wife was still upset with me.
I sighed and put the pot on the stove.
entradas.menu: Reheat the stew.

entradas.text: I called Serge and asked him to pick me up a pizza for dinner.
entradas.menu: Order a pizza.

entradas.text: While it was heating up, I went to the living room to fix myself a drink.
While I was waiting for him, I went into the living room to fix myself a drink.
Suddenly, the phone rang. I went back to the kitchen and answered it.
Franc's voice was on the other end.
"Oh. I thought Mom would pick up."
"Your mother works harder than I do these days."
entradas.menu: "Your mother works harder than I do these days."

entradas.text: "Oh, right. She was actually in the papers over here. They're calling her 'fierce'."
There was a long silence.
"Oh, right. My commander's worried women might be allowed into the military now. He thinks they're too emotional to serve."
"Oh, right. Deana's going to have a fit if she gets rid of girls' handicraft classes."
"She's off on her ladies' crusade, as usual."
entradas.menu: "She's off on her ladies' crusade, as usual."

entradas.text: "Sorry, you're stuck with your old man."
entradas.menu: "Sorry, you're stuck with your old man."

entradas.text: "Hello to you too, Franc."
entradas.menu: "Hello to you too, Franc."

entradas.text: "Sorry! Hi, Dad. Glad to catch you out of the office."
"Sorry."
"Ugh. Great."
"I didn't mean it that way! I just figured you'd be working."
"Uh... I got that record you sent me. Not bad for old folks' music."
"Have you heard anything from Uncle Petr?"
"How's Uncle Petr doing?"
"No."
entradas.menu: "No."

entradas.text: "That's still too painful to talk about."
entradas.menu: "That's still too painful to talk about."

entradas.text: "I haven't heard from him since the press conference."
entradas.menu: "I haven't heard from him since the press conference."

entradas.text: "I don't know, and I don't care."
entradas.menu: "I don't know, and I don't care."

entradas.text: "You take that back."

entradas.text: "Glad you liked it."

entradas.text: "Petr thought you might like it."

entradas.text: "Surprisingly well. He's actually seeing a therapist. He may even quit alcohol."

entradas.text: "Same as ever."

entradas.text: "He and Evelyn are divorcing."
entradas.menu: "He and Evelyn are divorcing."

entradas.text: "Oh, bummer. Not exactly a surprise, though."
entradas.menu: "Oh, bummer. Not exactly a surprise, though."

entradas.text: "Say hi to him for me."
entradas.menu: "Say hi to him for me."

entradas.text: "Wow. Did I just see a pig fly?"
"You know the military's worried about things escalating with Rumburg since you threw Livia in jail. They're moving more and more troops up near Mougwer."
"Uh, okay. It's so messed up what he did."
"So, how's school?"
entradas.menu: "So, how's school?"

entradas.text: "How's army life?"
entradas.menu: "How's army life?"

entradas.text: "Some of the profs here were hoping you'd hire a new VP who'd push you closer to Malenyevism."
"Some of the profs here were hoping you'd hire a new VP who'd push you closer to Arcasian ideals."
"Uh, okay. It's so messed up what he did."
"Queen Beatrice will back off if she knows what's good for her."
entradas.menu: "Queen Beatrice will back off if she knows what's good for her."

entradas.text: "I'll see what I can do to alleviate tensions. The last thing I want is my son going into battle."
entradas.menu: "I'll see what I can do to alleviate tensions. The last thing I want is my son going into battle."

entradas.text: "Rumburg instigated aggression against us. It must face the consequences."
entradas.menu: "Rumburg instigated aggression against us. It must face the consequences."

entradas.text: "No, it would've been too risky."

entradas.text: "Ha! Never."

entradas.text: "I know, Dad. I'm ready to fight if I have to."
"I'm ready to fight if I have to."
"So you do care about me, now that I'm out of the house."
"Even if that means sacrificing your only son. Got it."
"That whole scandal hasn't exactly helped with the protests here."
"So, got a girlfriend yet?"
entradas.menu: "So, got a girlfriend yet?"

entradas.text: "So, made any new friends yet?"
entradas.menu: "So, made any new friends yet?"

entradas.text: "So, made any new friends yet?"

entradas.text: "I have, actually. But some of the older guys are getting transferred up by Mougwer. In case things escalate with Rumburg."
"Absence makes the heart grow fonder."
entradas.menu: "Absence makes the heart grow fonder."

entradas.text: "I always did."
entradas.menu: "I always did."

entradas.text: "May it never come to that."

entradas.text: "That's my boy."

entradas.text: "It's all right. They keep talking about how things might escalate with Rumburg."
"Not that it's any of your business, but I might be seeing someone. She's no fan of yours, though. You know... With all the protests here."
"It's still mostly just the same guys from high school. I have to say, they're no fans of yours these days. A lot of student protests are happening here, you know..."
"It's fine, in between all the demonstrations."
"It's fine. Really different from Sordland. But I think I'm starting to fit in."
"Not that it's any of your business, but I might be seeing someone. She's really helped me understand the culture here."
"A few. They've really helped me understand the culture here."
"Nothing a bit of tear gas can't fix."

"That had nothing to do with my personal politics. It was simply the most convenient option."

"Well, it was the wrong move. Aligning with us is the only way forward."

entradas.menu: "Franc. I'd never put you on the front lines."

entradas.menu: "If it came to that, yes."

entradas.text: "So you'd put someone else's son there instead."
"If it came to it? I'd blow my own brains out before I died for you."
"I'm graduating from basic training soon. The commander says I could be the next Iosef Lancea."
"Actually, Dad..."
"I've been taking part in some of the protests."
"What?! You'll make me look like an idiot!"
entradas.menu: "What?! You'll make me look like an idiot!"

entradas.text: "Good for you. Exercise your right to freedom of speech."
entradas.menu: "Good for you. Exercise your right to freedom of speech."

entradas.text: "What?! You could get hurt!"
entradas.menu: "What?! You could get hurt!"

entradas.text: "You-- you're not mad at me?"
"If you have a problem with the way I'm doing things, take it up with me in person."
entradas.menu: "If you have a problem with the way I'm doing things, take it up with me in person."

entradas.text: "Stop protesting, or I'll personally order Karl to go over there and beat the shit out of every last one of you."
entradas.menu: "Stop protesting, or I'll personally order Karl to go over there and beat the shit out of every last one of you."

entradas.text: "No. I was a student once too, you know."
entradas.menu: "No. I was a student once too, you know."

entradas.text: "No. Just disappointed you wouldn't talk to me beforehand."
entradas.menu: "No. Just disappointed you wouldn't talk to me beforehand."

entradas.text: "Not everyone can get a personal audience with the President of Sordland, Dad. It sends a more powerful message if I'm there with my fellow citizens."
"Well, message received."
entradas.menu: "Well, message received."

entradas.text: "Too chicken to do it yourself? Typical."
"Fine, fine, I'll stop! Just don't hurt my friends."
"You were born with privilege. Take advantage of it."
entradas.menu: "You were born with privilege. Take advantage of it."

entradas.text: "All right. Next time I come for dinner I'll bring a list of our demands."
"My head's been stuffed with Sordish propaganda since the day I was born. Right now I feel like I'm thinking clearly for the first time."
"But I feel like you know that already."
"But I'm aware that you disagree."
"Oh, I am."
"It's 'us' now?"
entradas.menu: "It's 'us' now?"

entradas.text: "I think you're forgetting where you came from..."
entradas.menu: "I think you're forgetting where you came from..."

entradas.text: "If you like it over there so much, don't bother ever coming home."
entradas.menu: "If you like it over there so much, don't bother ever coming home."

entradas.text: "Don't come crying to me when you're stuck on the bread lines."
entradas.menu: "Don't come crying to me when you're stuck on the bread lines."

entradas.text: "Don't come crying to me if you get shot by some Arcasian gun nut."
entradas.menu: "Don't come crying to me if you get shot by some Arcasian gun nut."

entradas.text: "I'm happy you're opening your mind. Just stay away from reefer."

entradas.text: The doorbell rang. Serge was here with my pizza.
I suddenly became aware of a smoky smell coming from the kitchen. My dinner was burning.
I hung up the phone without saying goodbye to Franc.
entradas.menu: Hang up without saying anything.

entradas.text: "I have to go. Try calling your mother tomorrow."
entradas.menu: "I have to go. Try calling your mother tomorrow."

entradas.text: "Good catching up with you, Franc."
entradas.menu: "Good catching up with you, Franc."

entradas.text: "Yeah, okay. Bye, Dad."
We both hung up.
I let Serge in. The pizza he'd brought was gargantuan.
"Just leave it on the kitchen table."
entradas.menu: "Just leave it on the kitchen table."

entradas.text: "It would be an honor, sir."
"Sorry, sir. I've got to get back to my family."
"Enjoy your dinner, sir."
Serge left. I ate my pizza alone by the flickering light of the television, wondering when Monica and Deana would get home.
I brought the pizza into the living room and opened two beers. Serge and I sat down and ate together by the flickering light of the television.
I raced to the stove and turned off the burner. The bottom of the pot was charred, but part of the mystery stew was still salvageable.
I ate alone by the flickering light of the television, wondering when Monica and Deana would get home.
"Maybe I won't!"

"Watch your mouth, or I'll personally transfer you to the border myself."

entradas.text: "And not if you stop detaining people without just cause."
"The way things are going now, you don't need my help to look like an idiot."
"You can't make me. This is still a democracy, right?"
"See, that's the sort of attitude we're protesting against."
"You want a powerful message? How about I send Karl to beat the shit out of every last one of you?"
entradas.menu: "You want a powerful message? How about I send Karl to beat the shit out of every last one of you?"

entradas.text: "Just think about what we have to say. That's all I ask."
